coordinates.locator: centroid of OSM way 300971334 "Oak Ridge National Laboratory" (campus outline)
coordinates.note: A campus-grade point: the centre of the OpenStreetMap outline of the Oak Ridge National Laboratory main campus, within which HFIR stands. OpenStreetMap carries no object for the reactor itself and no fetched source gives its coordinate, so the PROSPECT hall position is not known to better than about 2 km.

depth_mwe.note: An upper bound: the source says "less than 1 meter water equivalent".
depth_mwe.quote: operating under less than 1 meter water equivalent overburden

name: ORNL High Flux Isotope Reactor experiment room
notes: PROSPECT-I sat at an estimated baseline of (7.93 +- 0.1) m from the reactor core centre in position 1 (NIM A 922, 287).

summary.plain: The experiment room beside the High Flux Isotope Reactor at Oak Ridge National Laboratory in Tennessee, where the PROSPECT detector sat a few metres from the reactor core at ground level.
summary.technical: Ground-level HFIR experiment room one floor above the reactor core and containment vessel (PROSPECT NIM A paper, section 4.1), under less than 1 m.w.e. of overburden. Marked with a campus-grade point for the ORNL main campus.
